headline: Four o'clock. Wind still across the roofs.
body: Fifteen degrees under mostly cloudy skies, wind from the west near twenty with gusts past forty. Streets remain dry while the near lanes carry their late-afternoon traffic. The sun sits high but soft behind the unbroken cover.
